prompt: Some people say it is the government's responsibility to transport children to school, while others believe parents should transport their children to school. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
In the contemporary era, adolescent safety is a major concern for everybody, and transporting them between their home and school is a noteworthy topic. Many believe that the government should be responsible for this, but others argue that parents themselves should be in charge of driving their kids to school. In this essay, I will talk about both sides of the problem and give my own view.

On one hand, I think that the responsibility of transporting kids between school and their residences should belong to the government. The government has funding from citizen taxes, so they should be capable of taking care of the children. Moreover, when they take care of various adolescents, they are going to use school buses with many priorities in driving, which is far safer than letting parents drive the kids on their own.

On the other hand, the parents should take their kids to school too. I believe that parents should take advantage of every chance they have to talk to their teenagers, and the period before or after going to school is a vital opportunity. Juveniles these days are being too distant from their parents because everyone is too busy minding their own business. The quality time of driving helps both juveniles and parents get to discuss their own problems and empathize with each other.

From my point of view, I assume that mothers and fathers should take the responsibility of transporting their kids and make the most of the driving time to become bestie with their children. However, the government should support the transportation of children, too, by managing traffic in school areas and prioritizing lanes for students.
